Isobel's Commentary: "These Ascendant Order thugs give knights a bad name. Glad you're doing something about them."
"This Magus character threatens the heart of my homeland. Honor demands we stop him."
"We're going to Amenos, are we? Stendarr keep us safe."
"You saved the alliance leaders! Stendarr's breath, what can't you do?"
"The Ascendant Order have eyes everywhere. We should be careful."
"Draigh, look at you. The hero of the day! And you've brought me along as part of the tale. Thank you, my friend. For everything."
"Because of you, we might see an end to this bitter, stupid war. It's an honor to ride with you, and be a blade in your service."
